info.description: Per-tenant module activation. Maps tenants to the product modules they are entitled to use.

tenant_id.description: Tenant identifier — matches default_tenant_id in system-config or deployment context

enabled.description: Whether this module is currently active for this tenant

config_overrides.description: Tenant-specific config overrides for this module (e.g. custom LLM model, delivery radius)

activated_by.description: Admin email or system that activated this entitlement
